About this video : "Qarib Qarib Single" - Standup Comedy By Rakesh Addlakha | Jokes & Crowdwork
Welcome to my latest comedy video for 2024! In this family-friendly, clean comedy video, I dive into some hilarious crowd work, engaging with the audience about their dating adventures, corporate experiences, and the often-overlooked quirks of HR and office life.
